The '''Darie system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Likasha sector/Legends|Likasha sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Darien lava-skimmer]].<ref name="TCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Darien lava-skimmer]]|system=Darie [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Darie system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square Q-14.<ref name="TEA" />
